title: FOMC BTC long from 75,400: deleveraging, two-sided event sweep, reclaim test

timeline.state: Price DOWN + CVD DOWN + OI DOWN
timeline.lesson: Treat first as deleveraging/exhaustion candidate, not automatic long confirmation.
CVD/OI stabilization plus lower-value reclaim improves the long candidate, but acceptance is still required.
The first event impulse is not directional confirmation; preserve the full path through both liquidity sweeps and post-event acceptance.

canonical_lessons: Event risk is a separate feature; ordinary order-flow confidence should be downgraded around FOMC/CPI/NFP.
Price response to CVD matters more than absolute CVD.
Price DOWN + CVD DOWN + OI DOWN is primarily deleveraging until fresh bearish leverage is shown.
A sweep/reclaim is not acceptance; require hold/retest.
Keep actual owner entry separate from model-recommended trigger to avoid hindsight contamination.
